current.text: He is projected to start for Denver next to Jamal Murray, Cam Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic.
DeMar DeRozan joined Denver and is projected to come off the bench.
If a starter loses minutes to DeRozan, it will most likely be Braun.
He could be the player Denver trades instead of Cam Johnson. The roster is unsettled and trades involving Johnson or Braun are possible.
Experts call him overvalued at his draft spot. He is not impactful enough at pick 134, overpriced at a Yahoo ADP of 120, and should not be ranked in the top 100.
He should beat last season's finish outside the top 200. Moore predicts a bounce-back year.
His 3P% fell from 40 to 30 last season, and defenses have figured him out.
His defense broke down last season, with poor containment and late rotations. He needs to create more steals and become a real stopper.
His steals may improve, because only 31% of his deflections became steals.
Denver has a good schedule: 43 games through March 28 and only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league. The team also has one of only three five-game weeks this season.

durable.text: He has been a low-usage player his whole career and has low shooting volume.
He is not a stat generator. He hurts the team's spacing, and opponents know it.
His ankle injury last season was more than a sprain. He tore several ligaments, and it hurt the athleticism his finishing depends on.
His 58% FG% season was not real. About 52% is already good for a perimeter player, so little improvement is expected.
His free throw shooting is usually below 80%. His 83% in the breakout year was an outlier.

note: Braun is a late flier for us, not a core piece. Yahoo ranks him 161 and ESPN 210, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he went for 7 USD in our league last season. His only plus categories are FG% (about 54% projected) and low turnovers. He is below the pool average in every counting stat. In the first weeks, check whether DeRozan takes his minutes, whether his 3P% and finishing come back after the ankle injury, and whether trade talk grows. If he slips to the last rounds or about 1 to 2 USD, he is a fine FG% and TO filler.
